name: Us Three Joined by Flesh
source:
Mirabell and Dahlia are invited to a Halloween party by their best friend Leila. However,  they are roped into her antics of completing a ritual that will grant their desires and make their dreams come true.

Despite wanting nothing to do with it they end up participating in the ritual through the night. 

[From [url=https://nimesoreol.itch.io/the-three-of-us-joined-by-flesh]itch.io[/url]]
